reviews.comment:
El club no es lo que supo ser. Una institución que se vino abajo, quedó anacrónica y sufrió fuertemente con la tercerización. El buffet muy bueno, el estacionamiento también. El taller, extremadamente descortés é ignorante el recepcionista, caro, ineficiente y mal atendido. El lubricentro bien, los dos locales de accesorios bastante bien surtidos, el que está sobre Brown tiene algunos precios levemente desmesurados, pero es cierto que no es un negocio especializado...

(Translated by Google)
The club isn't what it used to be. An institution that fell apart, became anachronistic, and suffered greatly from outsourcing. The buffet is very good, and so is the parking. The workshop, however, has an extremely rude and ignorant receptionist, is expensive, inefficient, and offers poor service. The lube center is fine, and the two accessory shops are fairly well-stocked; the one on Brown Street has some slightly excessive prices, but it's true that it's not a specialized business...

reviews.comment:
La verdad nunca me sentí tan mal en un lugar ,llegué para hacerme socio y asegurar mis dos vehículos y una moto (partner 2017--duna 94---- fz 2018) y me trataron como uno que pide limosna ,la verdad no entiendo porque la gente que trabaja en esa oficina de Colón no están capacitados para el trabajo que tienen que realizar ?
Después dicen que la cosa está mal pero por tel al 0800 del acá todo perfecto ,pero personalmente en la oficina una vergüenza

(Translated by Google)
I've never felt so bad in any place. I went there to become a member and insure my two cars and a motorcycle (a 2017 Partner, a 1994 Duna, and a 2018 FZ), and they treated me like I was begging for money. I really don't understand why the people who work in that Colón office aren't qualified for the job they're supposed to do.
Then they say things are bad, but on the phone at the 0800 number here, everything is perfect, but in person at the office, it's a disgrace.
